about.title: About Me
about.bio1: Hello! My name is Victor, I'm a Software Engineering student at FIAP, with practical experience in Full Stack development and a solid foundation in C++ acquired at UFBA.
about.bio2: I work on developing APIs, databases, and web applications, focusing on creating solutions that generate real impact and accelerate my technical and professional evolution.
about.bio3: I hold certifications such as CSA – Certified System Administrator and CIS – Customer Service Management. My hard skills include technologies like Node.js, Java, Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, as well as frameworks like Express.js, React, and Bootstrap.
about.bio4: I have experience with databases like MySQL, Oracle SQL Developer, and AWS RDS, as well as DevOps tools and practices like GitHub, Docker, Postman, and Azure DevOps.
about.bio5: I currently work as a Technical Consultant at AOOP (NTT DATA Company), where I have already worked on process automation for Azul Linhas Aéreas, implementing complex flows and integrations, always recognized for delivery quality.

project1.title: Clínica Dr. Wallace Victor
project1.description: Online medical appointment system developed with React, Node.js, Express, and AWS RDS. Full Stack.
project1.detailedDescription: Complete medical appointment system developed for Dr. Wallace Victor Clinic. The application allows patients to schedule appointments online intuitively, view available times, and receive automatic confirmations. The system includes a complete administrative panel for managing appointments, patients, and medical records.
features: Online scheduling - Schedule appointments easily and quickly
My Schedule - View, cancel, and reschedule your appointments
Appointment history - Access past and future appointments
Post-consultation evaluation - Rate the service with stars and comments
Document upload - Send exams and documents before the consultation
Complete profile - Manage personal data, allergies, and emergency contact
Automatic reminders - Receive email reminders 24h and 1h before
Export to calendar - Sync with Google Calendar or download .ics file
Dark mode - Switch between light and dark theme
PWA - Install as an app on your phone
Metrics dashboard - Charts of appointments, cancellation rate, reviews
Visual calendar - View entire schedule in calendar format
Patient management - Search, list, and manage patients
Schedule management - Block time slots and manage availability
project1.challenges: The main challenge was implementing a real-time scheduling system that would prevent time conflicts between multiple simultaneous users. The solution involved using SQL transactions and optimistic locks in the AWS RDS database.
